title: Make a floating finger
pause_note: Shorts v4: DO + WEIRD hook (fingertips approaching at 0 s), focus pull at ~4 s, floating finger at 7-10 s, a visible change every <= 2.5 s after it (H12), loop ending on frame one

beats: Touch your fingertips, about a hand's length from your eyes.
Now look past them, at something far away.
See it? A little floating finger, with two tips.
Pull them apart a bit. It floats.
Your eyes aim far, so each eye sees your fingers in a different place.
Your brain lays both views on top of each other.
Where the two fingertips overlap, you see a floating finger.
Look back at your fingers, and it is gone.
